name: Dazhuang

queries.query: Dazhuang Taiwan official cadastral parcel map Taichung GIS
queries.result: First-party Taichung GIS sources found. The Taichung spatial map viewer identifies cadastral positioning and the city GIS cloud publishes a cadastral layer, but the bounded anonymous parcel lookup did not return a safe feature response.

queries.query: 大庄 臺中 地籍圖 官方 地政 地籍定位
queries.result: 臺中市政府空間地圖查詢系統 and official land-office material identify public cadastral-map/search services. The current viewer configuration exposes section lookup and a cadastral layer; no safe anonymous parcel geometry was obtained.

discoveryMethod: Separate English and Traditional Chinese first-party discovery plus current Taichung viewer JavaScript/configuration and bounded anonymous service inspection.
sourceReview: Local Taichung municipal GIS and land-office custodianship is evidenced. The public viewer exposes cadastral positioning and the GIS cloud layer catalogue lists 地籍圖 (cadastral map), but current bounded parcel retrieval did not yield a safe ID-plus-geometry response. This is research evidence only, not source integration or runtime admission.

attemptsRecorded.outcome: Current Taichung spatial map viewer shell loaded. UI text exposes cadastral positioning and coordinate display in TWD97 two-degree zone and WGS84. No credentials, login, CAPTCHA, or private token was used.
Current JavaScript exposes POST routes CFM/getsec.cfm and CFM/locate_land.cfm, section-value lookup, and the cadastral layer name G97_PARCEL_P.

Official layer catalogue lists 地籍圖 with layer identifier GWH/Layers/ORA/G97_B_LNPAR_P and 1,613,257 records as of 2026-10-11. Catalogue metadata did not expose safe parcel features or a stable parcel identity field.

Anonymous section lookup returned JSON administrative/section metadata. It included 大庄段大庄小段(梧棲區), value 145205, and 大庄段火燒橋小段(梧棲區), value 145206, with TWD97-looking bounding coordinates. No parcel polygon was returned.

Bounded anonymous requests for section/lot keys 25932800010001, 14520500010001, and 14520600010001 returned an HTML/template response rather than parseable GeoJSON. This is an unusable response, not a zero-hit or citywide absence finding.

Official Dajia Land Office page states that Taichung's land-office electronic information system provides cadastral, land-price, and cadastral-map information for ten Taichung offices. It describes service custody/procedure, not an anonymous parcel feature API.

schemaAndCrs.viewerConfig: Current app_parcel.js was inspected; section metadata is JSON and locate_land.cfm is intended to return a GeoJSON-like object with features, but the bounded requests returned HTML.
schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: The viewer exposes TWD97 two-degree-zone and WGS84 coordinate displays; parcel response CRS was not verified.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: Not observed in a parcel feature response.
schemaAndCrs.compositeKeyProvenance: The viewer constructs a request key from section value plus zero-padded lot number, but no successful parcel response was obtained; no composite identity is retained.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: Exact WUP point [24.2365914463175, 120.545548452817] was preserved; no coordinate shift or exact-point parcel query was used.
boundedAnonymousResponse.result: No usable parcel feature response; no exact-point hit or miss inferred.

No citywide completeness, coverage boundary, update cadence, stable identity semantics, or parcel-layer CRS was verified.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, or title fields were requested or retained.
This packet is research evidence only and is not source integration or runtime admission.
uncertainty: Taichung municipal GIS and land-office service custody is first-party evidenced. The public viewer's current parcel lookup route was inspected, but bounded lot requests returned unusable HTML and no safe feature schema or geometry. A future viewer interaction or different public route may expose qualified parcels; runtime remains held pending independent serial review.
